definition_zh: 梭子；穿梭往返；定期班车（或航班）；航天飞机；羽毛球
definition_en: a small tool that carries thread back and forth in weaving, or any vehicle or service that travels regularly between two places, or the verb meaning to travel like that
core_image: 织机上一只木梭带着线，在两侧经线之间来回飞穿
scene: 织布的老屋里，女孩看着木梭在经线间飞快往返。Meanwhile a shuttle bus circled the campus through the window every ten minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 shuttle 是「往返班车」（第 3 个义项：在两个固定地点之间定期往返的交通工具）；句意为与此同时，透过窗户可见一辆班车每十分钟绕校园一圈。图中可辨识物件：织机、木梭、车窗、站牌。

pos.zh: 梭子；航天飞机；往返班车；羽毛球

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成名词，义为「往返穿梭」
shuttle 加 cock（公鸡）构成的复合词，指羽毛球
shuttle 加 -less（没有）构成，指无梭织机

senses.title: The weaving tool
senses.definition: a small rounded tool that carries the thread from side to side between the threads of a loom
senses.definitionCN: 织机上用来把纬线从一边送到另一边的小巧器械
senses.example: The weaver threw the shuttle across the loom.
senses.exampleCN: 织工把梭子从织机的一边抛到另一边。
senses.why: Old English scytel first meant a dart thrown quickly from hand to hand, and that flung motion shaped the weaving tool.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 scytel 原指被快速投出的飞镖，正是这种「被抛来抛去」的动作，塑造了梭子的形象。

senses.title: To move quickly back and forth
senses.definition: to travel often or quickly between two places, or to move rapidly to and fro
senses.definitionCN: 频繁或快速地往返于两地之间，或迅速地来回移动
senses.example: Porters shuttled between the platform and the carriage.
senses.exampleCN: 搬运工在站台与车厢之间来回奔走。
senses.why: Because the shuttle runs from side to side of the loom many times a minute, its name became a verb for any rapid back-and-forth trip.
senses.whyCN: 梭子每分钟要在织机两侧来回跑许多趟，它的名字于是被用成动词，指任何快速的来回行程。

senses.title: A regular connecting service
senses.definition: a bus, train, plane or other vehicle that travels regularly and often between two points at a fixed distance
senses.definitionCN: 在两点之间按固定班次频繁往返的公交车、火车、飞机等交通工具
senses.example: A free shuttle runs from the hotel to the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 有一趟免费班车往返于酒店和机场之间。
senses.why: A bus that repeats the same short route all day behaves exactly like a shuttle on a loom, so the tool name moved onto the vehicle.
senses.whyCN: 全天重复同一条短途路线的班车，行为就像织机上的梭子，于是器械之名转移到了交通工具上。

senses.title: The spacecraft
senses.definition: a reusable spacecraft that travels back and forth between Earth and orbit
senses.definitionCN: 在地球与轨道之间往返飞行的可重复使用航天器
senses.example: The shuttle docked with the station and delivered a new lab.
senses.exampleCN: 航天飞机与国际空间站对接，送去了一座新实验舱。
senses.why: This craft went up and came down again and again, so the image of a thing that keeps returning fitted it better than any one-off rocket.
senses.whyCN: 这种航天器一再升空又返回，正符合「不断折返之物」的意象，比一次性火箭更贴切。

senses.title: A badminton cork
senses.definition: the feathered cork ball hit to and fro in badminton, or the game itself
senses.definitionCN: 羽毛球运动中来回击打的带羽毛小球，也可指这项运动
senses.example: He batted the shuttle clear over the back line.
senses.exampleCN: 他把羽毛球打出了底线。
senses.why: The ball is struck from one side of the net to the other again and again, just like a shuttle crossing a loom.
senses.whyCN: 球在网的两侧被反复击打，恰似梭子穿过织机，所以它也叫 shuttle。

senses.title: The shuttlecock itself
senses.definition: the full noun for the feathered missile a player serves and returns, also called shuttlecock
senses.definitionCN: 球员发球与回击所用的带羽毛飞行物，全称是 shuttlecock
senses.example: The shuttle hit the net and dropped slowly to the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 羽毛球撞上网，慢慢落到了地上。
senses.why: Shuttle carries the motion and cock adds the feathered shape, so the full word names the object that keeps being sent back.
senses.whyCN: shuttle 承载「来回」的动作，cock 补上羽毛形状，合起来正指那只被不断打回的东西。

intro.en: Shuttle goes back to Old English scytel, a dart or missile, a word of Germanic origin; the weaving tool took the name because it is thrown across the loom.
intro.cn: shuttle 可上溯到古英语 scytel（飞镖、投掷物），属日耳曼语来源；织梭之所以得名，是因为它像镖一样被抛过织机。

items.en: Scytel meant a dart or javelin, something quick and thrown, and it belonged to a Germanic family of shooting and throwing words.
items.cn: scytel 意为飞镖或标枪，是快速而被投出的东西，属于日耳曼语中「射击、投掷」的词族。

items.en: By the later Old English period the word also named the weaver tool that darts to and fro carrying the weft thread.
items.cn: 到古英语后期，这个词也开始指织工手中带着纬线来回穿行的工具。

items.en: The form settled as shittle and then shuttle, and the tool sense became the dominant one.
items.cn: 词形先固定为 shittle，后又写作 shuttle，工具义成为主导义项。

items.en: The verb to shuttle appears, meaning to move briskly back and forth like the tool.
items.cn: 动词 to shuttle 出现，意为像梭子那样轻快往返。

items.en: Transport and technology borrowed the image: shuttle trains, shuttle flights, space shuttle, and later shuttle diplomacy.
items.cn: 二十世纪的交通与技术借用了这一意象：往返列车、穿梭航班、航天飞机，以及后来的穿梭外交。

note.en: Shuttle is the weaving word that became a travel word, so its neighbours are the loom on one side and ferries, flights and commutes on the other.
note.cn: shuttle 原是纺织用语，后来成为交通用语，所以它的邻居一边是织机，一边是渡轮、航班与通勤。

entries.definitionCN: 百叶窗；相机快门（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: the feathered ball used in badminton
entries.definitionCN: 羽毛球

entries.definition: a boat or service that carries people across water
entries.definitionCN: 渡船；摆渡服务

entries.definition: to travel regularly to and from work
entries.definitionCN: 通勤；往返上班

entries.definition: a vehicle designed to travel in space
entries.definitionCN: 航天器

normalIntro.en: Shuttle is a dart that became a loom tool and then a bus, so everything it names keeps going back and forth.
normalIntro.cn: shuttle 由飞镖变成织梭，又变成班车，所以它指的东西都在来回跑。

normal.en: Old English scytel was a dart, and only later a weaving tool.
normal.cn: 古英语 scytel 原是飞镖，后来才成为织梭。

normal.en: Shuttle and its near twin shuttlecock share the same back-and-forth idea.
normal.cn: shuttle 与近亲 shuttlecock 共享同一个「来回飞」的概念。

normal.en: A shuttle bus repeats one short route all day.
normal.cn: shuttle bus 整天重复同一条短路线。

normal.en: Shuttle flights link two nearby cities many times a day.
normal.cn: shuttle flight 让两座邻近城市一天多次互飞。

normal.en: Shuttle diplomacy describes a mediator who keeps flying between two sides.
normal.cn: shuttle diplomacy 形容调解人不停地在两方之间飞来飞去。

abstract.en: See a wooden shuttle flash across the threads, left to right and back again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只木梭在经线间一闪而过，从左到右再折回来。

abstract.en: Picture a small bus circling the same two stops like a bead on a wire.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆小巴像线上的珠子，在那两个站之间转个不停。

abstract.en: Think of a white spacecraft landing, rising again, landing again.
abstract.cn: 想象一架白色航天飞机降落、再升空、再降落。

examples.en: A shuttle runs between the car park and the terminal every five minutes.
examples.cn: 有一趟班车每五分钟往返于停车场和航站楼之间。

examples.en: Staff shuttled between the two labs all afternoon.
examples.cn: 员工整个下午在两间实验室之间来回奔波。

examples.en: The loom was fitted with an automatic shuttle.
examples.cn: 这台织机装了一只自动梭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沙头」——沙袋在织机两头来回甩，梭子也跟着来回跑；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 scytel（飞镖、投掷物）→ 古英语中兼指织梭 → 中古英语 shittle、shuttle → 现代英语 shuttle（梭子；往返班车；航天飞机），核心义「被迅速抛来抛去之物」。

sensesIntro.en: Shuttle starts as a thrown dart, becomes the tool that darts across a loom, then widens to people, buses, planes and spacecraft that keep returning between two points.
sensesIntro.cn: shuttle 先是被投出的飞镖，再成为在织机上飞穿的梭子，然后扩展到人、班车、飞机与航天器，凡在两点之间不断折返的事物都可以叫它。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden shuttle with a thread trailing behind it flies across the stretched threads and comes back.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只拖着线尾的木梭飞过绷紧的经线，又折返回来。

branches.en: The loom tool is the everyday concrete sense.
branches.cn: 织机上的梭子是最具体的日常义项。

branches.en: The verb names the motion the tool makes.
branches.cn: 动词义指梭子所做的那个动作。

branches.en: Buses, trains and spacecraft are vehicles that repeat the same short trip.
branches.cn: 班车、列车与航天飞机都是重复同一段短程的交通工具。

branches.en: The badminton ball takes its name from being hit to and fro.
branches.cn: 羽毛球因被来回击打而得名。

branches.en: All three senses are one image at different scales, from a hand tool to a public service.
branches.cn: 三个义项是同一意象在不同尺度上的呈现，从手持工具到公共服务。

intro.en: Shuttle is a native Germanic word, and English has built compounds and derivative forms around it, such as shuttlecock and shuttleless.
intro.cn: shuttle 是本族日耳曼词，英语围绕它造出复合词与派生形式，如 shuttlecock 与 shuttleless。

latinIntro.en: Shuttle has no Latin ancestor of its own, but Latin nouns for weaving tools help explain what the word names.
latinIntro.cn: shuttle 本身没有拉丁语祖先，但拉丁语中表示纺织工具的名词可以帮助理解它所指之物。

items.example: Scytel is the oldest known form of this English name.
items.exampleCN: scytel 是这个英语名称可以考知的最早形态。

items.example: The shuttle holds the weft thread.
items.exampleCN: 梭子装着纬线。

items.meaning: to move back and forth quickly
items.example: The hospital shuttles patients between wards.
items.exampleCN: 医院在各病区之间运送病人。

items.example: Shuttlecock joins the tool name to the word for cock.
items.exampleCN: shuttlecock 把工具名与「公鸡」一词组合起来。

items.example: A shuttleless loom fires the thread by air.
items.exampleCN: 无梭织机用气流射出纬线。

items.example: Shuttling between offices tired her out.
items.exampleCN: 在几个办公室之间来回跑让她筋疲力尽。

items.meaning: a mediator travelling between two sides
items.example: Shuttle diplomacy helped end the dispute.
items.exampleCN: 穿梭外交帮助结束了这场争端。

items.example: The suffix -less forms shuttleless.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -less 构成 shuttleless。

items.example: Space shuttle pairs a field of travel with the tool name.
items.exampleCN: space shuttle 把飞行领域词与工具名组合。

latinEntries.meaning: a shuttle, also the spoke of a wheel

definition_zh: 有点想吐的；稍有病意的；略微病态的；令人微觉不适的
definition_en: slightly ill or slightly nauseous, or in a mild way unhealthy or repulsive
core_image: 一个人扶着窗框缓口气，脸色有些发白，但还站得住
scene: 早晨的车厢里，年轻人盯着晃动的吊环，脸色有点发白。She felt sickish on the ferry and kept her eyes on the horizon.
sceneCN: 这里 sickish 是「有点想吐」（第 1 个义项：轻微的恶心感）；句意为她在渡轮上觉得有点想吐，便一直望着地平线。图中可辨识物件：吊环、窗框、渡轮栏杆、海平线。

pos.zh: 有点想吐的；稍有病意的；略微病态的；令人微觉不适的

derivatives.zh: sickish 加 -ness 构成名词，义为「轻微的不适」
sickish 的基础词，义为「生病的；想吐的」
基础词 sick 加 -ly，义为「多病的；病态的」，程度比 sickish 更重

senses.title: Slightly nauseous
senses.definition: feeling a little queasy, as if about to be sick, especially after motion or rich food
senses.definitionCN: 略感反胃，好像快要吐出来，尤指在颠簸或吃得太油腻之后
senses.example: The winding road left him sickish for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 蜿蜒的山路让他恶心了将近一个小时。
senses.why: The -ish suffix means somewhat, so sickish turns full sickness into a light, passing nausea.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ish 表示「有点儿」，于是 sickish 把十足的病症化成一阵轻微、短暂的反胃。

senses.title: A little unwell
senses.definition: not properly ill but not quite well either, as if a cold or fever is coming
senses.definitionCN: 不算真正生病，却也说不上舒服，仿佛感冒或发烧要来了
senses.example: I woke up sickish and decided to stay home.
senses.exampleCN: 我醒来时有些不对劲，就决定待在家里。
senses.why: Because -ish marks a half state, sickish is the word for being only part of the way toward real illness.
senses.whyCN: 由于 -ish 表示只做到一半，sickish 正指只往生病靠近了一半的状态。

senses.title: Mildly unhealthy in quality
senses.definition: unpleasantly pale, weak or unhealthy in appearance, taste or atmosphere, without being fully so
senses.definitionCN: 在外观、气味或氛围上透着不健康的苍白或虚弱，但尚未到明显病态
senses.example: The lamp gave the kitchen a sickish yellow glow.
senses.exampleCN: 那盏灯让厨房笼罩着一层病态的昏黄。
senses.why: The suffix can attach an unhealthy quality to things, so a colour, a light or a smell may be sickish too.
senses.whyCN: 后缀也能把「不健康」的性质附着到事物上，所以颜色、光线、气味都可以是 sickish。

senses.title: Slightly repulsive
senses.definition: mildly disgusting or unsettling, causing a faint sense of unease rather than strong disgust
senses.definitionCN: 有点令人反感或不安，引起淡淡的不适，而非强烈的厌恶
senses.example: There was something sickish about the way he described the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 他描述那场事故的方式让人有些不适。
senses.why: Sick began to mean sickening long ago, so sickish can describe something that makes a listener feel disturbed rather than physically ill.
senses.whyCN: sick 早在过去就有「令人作呕」之意，所以 sickish 也能形容让人心里不适、却未必真的反胃的事物。

intro.en: Sickish is an English formation from the adjective sick plus the Old English suffix -ish, meaning somewhat, so it is a native word built in English rather than borrowed.
intro.cn: sickish 是英语自己造的词，由形容词 sick 加古英语后缀 -ish（有点……）构成，并非从外语借来。

items.en: Seoc meant ill or diseased, and it had Germanic relatives in other languages of the family.
items.cn: seoc 意为生病的、有病的，在日耳曼语族其他语言中也有同源词。

items.en: The form passed into Middle English as sik, and the spelling settled as sick.
items.cn: 词形进入中古英语写作 sik，拼写后来固定为 sick。

items.en: The suffix -isc, ancestor of -ish, meant belonging to or having the quality of, later softening to somewhat.
items.cn: 后缀 -isc 是 -ish 的前身，表示「属于……或具有……性质」，后来弱化为「有点儿」。

items.en: Sickish appears in early modern English, describing a person who is only partly sick.
items.cn: sickish 出现在近代英语早期，用来形容只是有点生病的人。

items.en: The sense widened from bodily illness to pale colours, stale smells and mildly unpleasant ideas, and it stays formal rather than everyday.
items.cn: 词义从身体不适扩展到苍白的颜色、陈腐的气味与不大令人愉快的想法，语气仍偏书面，而非日常口语。

note.en: Sickish is sick with a softener at its end, so its look-alikes are the words that grow from sick, while its near meanings are the half-ill words of nausea and weakness.
note.cn: sickish 就是在 sick 后面加了一个「减弱」成分，所以形近词都从 sick 长出来，近义词则是那些表示「半病未病」的词。

entries.definitionCN: 生病的；想吐的

entries.definition: often ill, or looking weak and unhealthy
entries.definitionCN: 多病的；病态的

entries.definition: the state of being ill
